rows.standfirst: Toryo Ito, a Japanese Zen Buddhist monk, is bringing ancient mediative practices to professionals all around the world, including staffers at businesses like Meta and Sony.

rows.title: This high school dropout now makes six figures at OpenAI—and he shares the strategy Gen Z can use to get hired in Silicon Valley, too
rows.standfirst: Gabriel Petersson landed a job at OpenAI—without a college degree—or even a high school diploma. His secret: showing he was up for the job.

rows.title: The ROAD Act passed by the Senate aims to expand America’s housing supply. It’s likely to shrink it instead
rows.standfirst: The ROAD Act aims to keep big investors out of the single family home rental market. Critics say that could kill investment in new homes, and drive up prices.

rows.title: America has a workforce crisis. The solution is already here — and it’s being wasted
rows.standfirst: A neurosurgeon driving Uber. A civil engineer stocking shelves. Millions of work-authorized, highly trained immigrants can fill the labor shortage now.

rows.title: Sony raises PlayStation price another $100, second price hike in under a year
rows.standfirst: Citing “continued pressures in the global economic landscape,” the Japanese company said the PS5 will cost $649.99 in the U.S.

rows.title: This ex-Google CMO quit at 28 years old with a seven-figure equity package and says climbing the ladder was easy: ‘I just disregarded all the rules’
rows.standfirst: By 28, Alon Chen had a seven‑figure equity package and a CMO title at Google. He says promotions were “easy” once he ignored every rule—and then he quit anyway.

rows.title: Netflix cofounder Reed Hastings says his first boss out of college would wash his dirty mugs at 4:30 a.m.—so now he does coffee runs for his staff too
rows.standfirst: After self-made billionaire Reed Hastings found out his boss was washing his dirty mugs, he’s learned to stay humble and connect with staffers—by giving them coffee in fresh cups.

rows.title: A CEO trying to reindustrialize America says blue-collar pay is headed for ‘massive hyperinflation’ and kids should skip college to become welders
rows.standfirst: Hadrian CEO Chris Power said it’s time to tell your kids to ditch the four-year degree and enter the trades.

rows.title: Trump said the Iran war was ‘very complete’ three weeks ago. Oil has surged 50% since, and analysts are warning of stagflation
rows.standfirst: Gas prices just hit their highest level since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and Wall Street is bracing for stagflation as the conflict spreads.

rows.title: Bill Ackman told spooked investors to get over the Iran war and buy Fannie and Freddie. Stocks surged 40% the next day
rows.standfirst: The Pershing Square Capital Management CEO is the largest shareholder in each company and stands to benefit the most from the stock surge.

rows.title: Gas prices under Trump just hit a benchmark from the Biden inflation era
rows.standfirst: U.S. gas prices jumped past an average of $4 a gallon for the first time since 2022 on Tuesday as the Iran war pushed fuel prices to soar worldwide.

rows.title: Markets cheer as Trump threatens to abandon Iran war, but Jamie Dimon sides with allies: ‘Win this thing and clean up the straits’
rows.standfirst: The White House is signaling that it’s ready to leave the strait in allies’ hands: “The USA won’t be there to help you anymore, just like you weren’t there for us.”

rows.title: Marc Andreessen says AI layoffs are a farce: Companies are 75% overstaffed, and AI is the ‘silver bullet excuse’ to clean house
rows.standfirst: The venture capitalist thinks companies are citing AI as an excuse to cut down workforces for alternative reasons.

rows.title: Hiring just hit a level not seen since the economy was ‘closed down literally’ during COVID, top economist says
rows.standfirst: The war with Iran could make companies start firing, Navy Federal Credit Union’s Heather Long said.
